description: Greenhouse monitoring and control: Raspberry Pi 4B, environmental sensors, irrigation control. 24/7 agricultural automation.

availability.title: Greenhouse agent unavailable
diagnosisSteps: Check Raspberry Pi power and network
Review degradation mode: is agent in Offline/Degraded?
Review mesh observability traces for last successful delegation
mitigationSteps: Check data/outbox queue for pending writes
Force flush outbox to cloud on reconnection
Verify sensor daemon is running (python3 sensor-daemon.py)
availability.escalationTrigger: If agent is down >30 minutes or irrigation cannot be triggered, escalate to field technician.

responseTime.title: Greenhouse response time degraded
diagnosisSteps: Check if degraded mode is active
Review budget: is LLM fallback to cheaper model happening?
mitigationSteps: Switch to degraded mode with deterministic routing
responseTime.escalationTrigger: If P95 latency >5s for >15 minutes, escalate to operations.

dataLoss.title: Greenhouse sensor data loss
diagnosisSteps: Check outbox pending count via /api/backups endpoint
Check cellular data usage and quota
mitigationSteps: Switch to LTE if WiFi is degraded
dataLoss.escalationTrigger: If >100 events lost in 24h, escalate to operations.

recoveryTime.title: Greenhouse recovery time exceeded
symptoms: Agent recovering from outage in >15 min
diagnosisSteps: Check recovery trigger: was it network or power?
mitigationSteps: Run manual eval to confirm agent health
recoveryTime.escalationTrigger: If recovery takes >30 minutes, escalate to field technician.

cost.title: Greenhouse daily cost budget exceeded
mitigationSteps: Switch to cheaper LLM model (e.g., gpt-4o-mini)
cost.escalationTrigger: If cost consistently >$10/day, escalate to operations for architecture review.
